source.post_text: Uh so how many K’s does Walter Johnson actually have because I’m seeing 3508, 3509 and the MLB account is saying 3515

replies.text: Official stat keeper for MLB @EliasSports has him at 3515 so that’s what I’ll go with… But overall record keeping has some discrepancies from that time.

replies.text: Official MLB stats were going off 3515

replies.text: Historical strikeout tallies from that era often differ by a few depending on the source, so landing on the MLB/Elias figure of 3515 feels like the most reliable option overall.
